skills.officialText: 锁定技，你的攻击范围始终等于你的当前体力值。当你使用【杀】指定唯一目标时，若目标的攻击范围小于等于你，你令此【杀】伤害+1，然后获得该角色一张手牌；若目标的攻击范围大于等于你，你弃置该角色区域内一张牌，选择一名角色成为此【杀】的额外目标。

textDeterminedRules: The two inclusive comparisons are independent: equal attack ranges perform both branches, not an exclusive choice.
Jiaodi modifies the original Slash. There is no second fabricated Use or additional material payment; its whole-Slash damage increase also applies to its added target.
The original Slash must have exactly one other designated target. Pure Played and an originally multi-target Slash do not qualify.
A legal extra target must be selected when one exists; the official final clause has no optional refusal.
Baojing is limited per actual own Play phase and expires at the next own Play phase beginning. A skipped Play is not a Play beginning, and an inserted Play is a real next Play.
engineeringInterpretationsNotOfficialFaq: At acceptance of the native original sole-target designation, freeze the source instance/hash, original Use/action/target and both public attack ranges. Physical obtain/discard children cannot later recompute or reverse these already-accepted comparisons.

Resolve in text order: issue +1 to the original whole Slash, actually obtain one current target Hand card, drain its native children, then actually discard one current target Hand/Equipment/Judgment card and drain its children before the mandatory legal extra-target choice. Empty zones or no legal extra target skip only the unavailable action.

The explicit 始终 range is a final absolute nonnegative current-HP projection while the Jiaodi source is active, overriding weapon, ordinary Set/Add and Unlimited contributions. Actual HP0 therefore yields range0. Other players retain the existing native arithmetic.

Baojing is an issued finite +/-1 contribution. A live negative Baojing preserves a finite recipient minimum one even where a native weapon normally permits zero. Jiaodi's explicit absolute current-HP projection has priority over Baojing, including its real zero during dying; unrelated native zero or Unlimited values are not changed.
The chosen Baojing contribution remains issued after source loss until its first later actual own Play start; source regrant does not refresh its existing duration or current-phase usage.

Already-accepted Jiaodi movement children preserve the original frame/source and cannot take or discard twice after a child return or checkpoint restore. Death/terminal cutoff follows native resolution; no dead chooser is given a new private decision.

Foreign Hand selection uses native opaque slots. Actual obtained entities use face-down movement disclosure; equipment/judgment selection and logical discard keep their native visibility and recovery effects.
